profile_text.body:
Zscaler is a publicly traded cloud security company founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Jose, California, trading on Nasdaq under the ticker ZS. The company describes itself as a leading cloud enterprise security provider focused on zero trust architecture for enterprises undergoing digital transformation. Its flagship platform, the Zero Trust Exchange, is marketed as operating on what the company calls the largest security cloud on the planet, and the site emphasizes capabilities around data lineage tracing and governance of agent-to-agent interactions as priorities for compliance and competitive advantage.

The company's tracked AI product, Zscaler AI, sits within the Security and Identity AI category and encompasses cloud security AI, a security service edge platform, data loss prevention, and AI traffic inspection. Zscaler maintains a broad partner and integration ecosystem that the company says enables faster deployments and more agile operations for enterprise customers.

The site holds an SEC profile under CIK 0001713683, confirming Zscaler's status as a for-profit public company. The held facts also note 175 cases of legal exposure associated with California, though no specific litigation details are recorded in the available data.
